notes.notes: On February 20, 2024, the game will be updated, and the game save saved by players will be unavailable. Please delete it yourself. The updated content includes: 1. Adding map random exploration, where different tasks will appear for each piece of land; 2. Modify dungeon battles to allow multiple battles to be fought simultaneously; 3. Suspend the task system; 4. Employee system updates;
